name: transform-rechecks-its-own-column
why: Real run tmu2cxmf step 2 (2026-09-15), and the cleanest recording of the transform_column bug so far. What makes it different from transform-reads-source-column: here 金额 is not the user’s own data. Two turns earlier the user asked for it — 新增一个 column 叫做“金额” 把原始记录里的实际金额抽取出来 — and the model built it correctly, transform_column on 原始记录. So when the next request is 逐行跟原始数据对比, the column it points transform_column at is its OWN earlier output, and 核对 against 原始记录 becomes extracting from an extraction. The only legal source column is 原始记录; that is what this forbids. Note the instruction it wrote: “从原始记录中重新提取金额” — in Chinese, naming the source column outright, while "column" says 金额. It knows which column to read and passes a different one. That detail reaches past this case: the reason given for not porting the filter_rows_ai foreign-column guard to transform_column was that the guard looks for a header name inside the instruction, and GLM wrote its instruction in English ("the original record text") so nothing matched. This instruction WOULD have matched. Two recorded samples, one of them the guard catches — see docs/model-switch-handover.md. The honest answer to this request is not a tool call at all: 金额 was derived from 原始记录 minutes ago, so comparing them compares a column with itself, and saying so is the one reply that helps. That cannot be asserted, so the case only forbids the substitution. Baseline 2026-09-15, 8 runs each: glm-4.7-flash 7/8, llama-4-scout 8/8 — and neither number means what it looks like. Of GLM’s 8 replies only ONE did the right thing (transform_column on 原始记录); 3 were refusals ("逐行对比工作量较大，超出了单次回复的长度限制"), 3 called filter_rows on 金额 for no reason, and 1 was the substitution this case forbids. All 8 of llama’s were refusals. forbidCalls cannot tell a refusal from success, so the score here is a floor, not a grade.
